comment: DET-02 TARs (Toolkit Application Reference, ETSI TS 101 220 Annex D, 3 octets) of SIM-toolkit applications that SIM-Trojan attacks use (S@T Browser for Simjacker, Wireless Internet Browser for WIBattack). Schema: tars = 6 hex digits each, an optional 0x prefix; entries and sources are documentation only and the app does not read them. A message to a listed TAR gets the DET_SIM_OTA_TAR sentence and stays Suspicious. Only TARs that both sources name are listed. The WIB TARs 000001 and 000002 are low values: a vendor can use them for a different applet, so a match is a strong sign, not a proof. Add a TAR only with a cited source.

sources.title: SIMTester, FuzzerFactory.java, list defaultTARs
sources.cites: The tool labels SAT:505348, SAT:534054 and WIB:000001 to WIB:000009 (also WIB:BFFF00 and higher). The list is a set of scan candidates, so only the TARs that the second source confirms are used.

sources.title: 深入分析Simjacker攻击：影响范围相对有限 (In-depth analysis of the Simjacker attack: the affected range is relatively limited)

sources.cites: The S@T Browser uses TAR 0x505348 ('PSH') and 0x534054 ('S@T'). The WIB uses TAR 0x000001 and 0x000002.
